headline: South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay on Crypto Gains Tax Until 2029
summary: South Korean officials are considering delaying the implementation of a cryptocurrency gains tax to 2029, citing concerns that domestic exchange users would bear an unfair burden because the U.S. will not share trading data until then.
why: South Korea hosts one of the world's most active retail cryptocurrency trading populations and frequently reviews digital asset regulations.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Exchanges
impacts.why: Delaying capital gains taxes on crypto removes an immediate tax burden for traders, potentially sustaining retail trading volumes on domestic exchanges.
